_comment: How an inferno climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: fire goes out in rain by vanilla's own rule, so an inflicted inferno in a
wet Age is a nuisance and in a dry one is a siege -- and which of those it is falls out of the Age's own
climate rather than out of anything written here.
Two dials, and either one bought sets the Age alight. `burn_damage` is how much it hurts to stand out
under open light, on top of vanilla's own burning. `light_intensity` is how dim that light may get
before the burning stops: none of it is daylight only, as a written inferno is, and all of it burns
under the moon. Both are harm.
Leans hot and dry. A blizzard's ladder says it never shares an Age with one.
